description: This file defines the OrganizationsMembershipRepository class, which manages CRUD operations for organization memberships using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application.

classes.name: OrganizationsMembershipRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing organization memberships with methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: findOrgMembership
methods.description: Finds a specific organization membership by organization and membership IDs.

methods.name: findOrgMembershipByUserId
methods.description: Finds an organization membership by organization ID and user ID.

methods.name: deleteOrgMembership
methods.description: Deletes an organization membership by organization ID and membership ID.

methods.name: createOrgMembership
methods.description: Creates or updates an organization membership with provided data.

methods.name: updateOrgMembership
methods.description: Updates an existing organization membership with new data.

methods.name: findOrgMembershipsPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of organization memberships.
